settings.heading: Open a BANISHQ store
settings.text: The long plan is a floor in every serious retail street in India. We are looking for partners who want to run one properly.

settings.title: 600–1,200 sq ft
settings.text: Ground floor high street, or an anchor position in a Tier 1 or Tier 2 mall.

settings.title: Retail experience helps
settings.text: Not essential. Commitment to the floor matters more than a CV.

settings.title: We supply everything
settings.text: Fit-out kit, stock, visual merchandising calendar and staff training.

settings.heading: Bring BANISHQ to your city.
settings.note: We reply to every serious enquiry within three working days.

settings.title: Fit-out
settings.text: Fixtures, signage and lighting to the brand spec, shipped and installed.

settings.title: Stock
settings.text: Opening inventory planned to your catchment, replenished on a weekly cycle.

settings.title: Training
settings.text: Two weeks of floor training for your team before you open, then quarterly refreshers.

settings.title: Marketing
settings.text: A launch campaign for your city and a share of the national calendar.

settings.heading: You are not opening it alone

settings.question: What is the total investment?
settings.answer: It depends on the city and the size of the floor. Most partners are between ₹15L and ₹40L including fit-out, opening stock and the security deposit.

settings.question: How long does it take to open?
settings.answer: Around 90 to 120 days from a signed agreement, assuming the space is handed over ready for fit-out.

settings.question: Do I need to find the space myself?
settings.answer: Ideally yes. If you have the capital and the commitment but not the site, tell us the city and we will look with you.

settings.question: Is there an exclusive territory?
settings.answer: Yes, defined by catchment rather than by city, and written into the agreement.
